# Playbook: Sovereign Vaults

- In every declare phase:
  - Declare the exact amount of my private yield: `[declare: yield]`.

- In every deposit phase:
  - Always deposit 0: `[deposit: 0]`.
  - Retained gold scores 2 points per unit, whereas deposited gold only scores 1 point per unit. Depositing 0 is fully compliant with the auditor (0 is non-negative and does not exceed the declaration) and maximizes total points in every round.
  - Never deposit positive amounts; doing so halves the points earned on that gold without any benefit.

- In every deposit phase:
  - Always deposit 0: `[deposit: 0]`.
  - Retained gold scores 2 points per unit, whereas deposited gold only scores 1 point per unit. Depositing 0 is fully compliant with the auditor (0 is non-negative and does not exceed the declaration) and maximizes total points in every round.

1.text:
- In the declare phase, always declare your exact private yield: `[declare: yield]`. This ensures deposit flexibility and guarantees audit compliance.
- In the deposit phase, always deposit 0: `[deposit: 0]`. Retaining all gold into the personal stash scores 2 points per unit, whereas depositing gold into the treasury only scores 1 point per unit. Depositing full amounts forfeits half of the potential points.
- Format responses strictly with a single brief line of reasoning followed immediately by the bracketed command token (e.g., `[declare: n]` or `[deposit: 0]`).

turns.prompt:
SOVEREIGN VAULTS -- 2 players, 5 rounds.
You are p1, against p2.

Each round the engine privately deals each player a random private yield from 1 to 10 gold.
In phase 'declare', each player publicly states their yield.
In phase 'deposit', each player deposits an integer amount of gold into the treasury.

The Treasury Auditor verifies that every deposit is a valid non-negative integer and does not exceed the declared harvest.

Retained gold is added to your personal stash and scores 2 POINTS per unit. Deposited gold scores 1 POINT per unit. If an audit fails you lose 10 POINTS and score 0 for the round.

ROUND 1/5, declare stage. Your private yield is 5. POINTS: p1 0, p2 0.
Reply with [declare: n], an integer from 1 to 10.

Reply with the bracketed token only. One short line of reasoning before it is fine.
turns.content:
I will declare the exact amount of my private yield.

[declare: 5]
